std:ui.name: CodeEditorProps
std:ui.documentation:
A source-code editor with highlighting, line numbers, folding, selection and find/replace. Omit value for local editing (optionally seeded by defaultValue), or set value and handle onChange for controlled text. controlInput and readInput address it by id. Offsets are UTF-8 bytes. Show Hover in the context menu, or Cmd+K then Cmd+I on macOS (Ctrl+K then Ctrl+I elsewhere), shows documentation at the caret from the hover provider; Escape dismisses it. Ownership: the mounted node owns its editor state.

Props (all optional):
- `value`: Controlled full text. Omission preserves local edits; a changed value replaces the buffer. Pair with onChange to retain user edits.
- `language`: Highlighting language, such as rust, typescript or json (tsr selects TypeScript, tsrx selects TSX). Read when mounted; omitted, the text is plain.
- `readOnly`: Prevents edits.
- `id`: Identifier for controlInput and readInput. Use a unique, nonempty name in this window.
- `defaultValue`: Initial text when value is omitted. Read once at mount; later changes do not replace edits.
- `placeholder`: Hint shown while the buffer is empty. Defaults to empty.
- `disabled`: Prevents editing and focus. Defaults to false.
- `appearance`: false removes the field background and border. Defaults to true.
- `bordered`: false removes the border while preserving the background. Defaults to true.
- `accessibilityLabel`: Accessible editor name, such as Source code.
- `tabIndex`: Keyboard focus order. Defaults to zero.
- `role`: Optional accessibility role override. Omission keeps the editor text-field role.
- `size`: Padding density. Defaults to medium; className controls code font size.
- `autoFocus`: Focuses this editor when it mounts. Defaults to false.
- `lineNumbers`: Shows source line numbers. Defaults to true.
- `initialAnchor`: Fixed end of the native editor's initial selection, in UTF-8 bytes. With initialCaret, selects between the two offsets and preserves direction. Defaults to initialCaret.
- `initialCaret`: Initial UTF-8 byte offset in the native editor. Read once after mounting its text. Offsets clip to a character boundary inside the document.
- `breakpointLines`: Comma-separated one-based source lines marked in the native editor gutter, for example '2,5'. An empty string shows an empty gutter. Omission hides it. Requires visible line numbers.
- `folding`: Enables gutter folding. Defaults to true; disabling unfolds existing ranges.
- `autoClose`: Automatically closes matching brackets and quotes. Defaults to true.
- `smartIndent`: Uses language-aware indentation when typing. Defaults to true.
- `indentGuides`: Shows indentation guides. Defaults to true.
- `cleanOnEscape`: Escape clears the editor when true. Defaults to false.
- `submitOnEnter`: true emits onSubmit on Enter instead of inserting a newline. Defaults to false.
- `contextMenu`: false disables the built-in right-click edit menu. Defaults to true.
- `showWhitespace`: Shows spaces and tabs as visible marks. Defaults to false.
- `textAlign`: Text alignment. Defaults to left.
- `scrollBeyondLastLine`: Extra rows scrollable past the final line. Nonnegative; omission keeps the Kit default.
- `cursorSurroundingLines`: Rows kept visible around the cursor. Nonnegative; omission keeps the Kit default.
- `enterKeyHint`: Touch keyboard Enter label. Read at mount; defaults to enter.
- `autoCorrect`: Platform autocorrection. Read at mount; omission keeps the platform default.
- `autoCapitalize`: Platform capitalization. Read at mount; omission keeps the platform default.
- `replaceable`: Allows find/replace rather than find alone. Read at mount; defaults to true.
- `softWrap`: Wraps long source lines. Omission keeps the Kit editor default.
- `searchable`: Enables find and the search actions of controlInput. Defaults to true.
- `scrollBounce`: Enables elastic overscroll. Omission keeps the Kit default.
- `wrappingIndent`: Wrapped-line indentation. Omission keeps the Kit default.
- `tabSize`: Spaces per indentation level. Positive integer; defaults to two.
- `hardTabs`: Uses a tab character with tabSize rather than spaces. Defaults to false.
- `onChange`: Receives the full text after each edit.
- `onFocus`: Runs when the editor gains keyboard focus.
- `onBlur`: Runs when the editor loses keyboard focus.
- `onSubmit`: Runs on Enter submission; secondary reports Cmd on macOS or Ctrl elsewhere.
- `onPaste`: Called with JSON {text, paths, imageCount} before a paste (text may be null). Return true to consume the paste yourself, false to insert the text normally. Errors stop the application. Skipped on web platforms without synchronous clipboard access.
- `onLanguageRequest`: Receives JSON {id, method, params, text} for hover, completion, signature help, definition and references (positions in UTF-16). Reply with answerEditorLanguage within five seconds. Omit to disable these features.
- `onSelectionChange`: Receives a JSON pair [anchor, caret] of UTF-8 byte offsets when the primary selection changes in the native editor. Equal endpoints indicate an insertion point.
- `onCaretChange`: Receives the active caret's UTF-8 byte offset when it moves in the native editor, including keyboard navigation without edits.
- `onBreakpointClick`: Receives the one-based source line when the user clicks the native breakpoint gutter. Update breakpointLines to change the markers. Wrapped rows refer to their original source line.
- `onInlineCompletion`: Receives JSON {id, prefix, suffix} (the text before and after the caret) when typing pauses. Reply with answerEditorLanguage(id, JSON.stringify(insertion), callback) to show a suggestion, or 'null' for none. Tab accepts and Escape dismisses it.
- `onLanguageCancel`: Receives the window-scoped request id when a native language read is cancelled, replaced or expires. Cancel the matching server read; late replies are ignored.
- `onLanguageNavigate`: Receives LSP ShowDocumentParams JSON for Go to Definition. Check the file URI and selection, then open the target. Omit to disable navigation.
- `onLanguageReferences`: Receives JSON {locations, error} after Find References (Shift+F12): an array of LSP Locations and an optional error message. Show the locations yourself; check each URI and range before opening it.
- `className`: Utility classes. A signal expression updates them live without remounting; unknown utilities throw.

```tsrx

```

std:ui.name: DiffProps
std:ui.documentation:
A read-only, scrolling view of a unified or Git patch, one section per changed file. Changing patch replaces the files; invalid patch text stops the application with its line and message. Instead of patch, pass originalText, modifiedText and filePath to compare two full texts in the background. For example, <Diff patch={patch} mode="split" softWrap={true}/> wraps both columns. Callbacks receive JSON with file paths and one-based line numbers. Ownership: the mounted node owns its comparison state.

Props (all optional):
- `patch`: Unified diff text, as printed by git diff. Omit when using originalText and modifiedText.
- `mode`: One column, or old and new side by side. Defaults to unified.
- `lineNumbers`: Shows original and modified source line numbers. Defaults to true.
- `syntaxHighlight`: Colors recognized source languages. Defaults to true; unknown languages remain plain text.
- `headerVisible`: Shows each file header and its collapse control. Defaults to true.
- `hoverHighlight`: Emphasizes the hovered code row, number gutter or both. Defaults to none.
- `hunkSeparator`: Displays the Git hunk header (default), omitted-line count or a thin divider.
- `changeIndicator`: Marks changed rows with plus/minus signs (default), colored bars or no gutter mark.
- `changeBackground`: Tints added and removed row backgrounds. Defaults to true.
- `softWrap`: Wraps long source lines within the view. Defaults to false; horizontal scrolling preserves source lines.
- `contextLines`: Unchanged lines shown around changes. Defaults to 3; -1 shows all available context. Other negative values throw. Cannot recover lines omitted from the patch.
- `expansionLines`: Lines revealed by one unchanged-section disclosure. Defaults to 20; requires an integer >= 1.
- `minCollapsedLines`: Minimum unchanged run kept collapsed. Defaults to 2; requires an integer >= 1.
- `inlineUnit`: Emphasizes changed words (default), Unicode characters, or whole lines only.
- `inlineMaxLineLength`: Maximum source-line byte length for inline comparison. Defaults to 1000; requires an integer >= 1. Longer lines retain whole-line coloring.

std:ui.name: DataTableProps
std:ui.documentation:
A virtualized table over many rows: sortable, resizable and movable columns, fixed columns, row, column or cell selection, a right-click menu and incremental loading. Columns come from DataTableColumn children; give it a height with className. Explicit text-size classes size plain cells and grow the default row height to fit; headerRowHeight remains an explicit override.

Props (all optional):
- `rows`: The cells as JSON: an array of rows, each an array of cell values (`JSON.stringify(rows)`). Non-string values show as JSON text.
- `columns`: Column titles, when there are no DataTableColumn children. A signal expression updates it live; a plain array is read once.
- `stripe`: Alternates row backgrounds.
- `bordered`: false removes the outer border. Defaults to true.
- `sortable`: false turns off sorting for every column. Defaults to true; each column opts in with `sortable`.
- `rowSelectable`: false turns off row selection. Defaults to true.
- `columnSelectable`: Clicking a non-sortable header selects the column. Sortable headers change the sort instead.
- `cellSelectable`: Selects single cells instead of rows; arrow keys move between cells.
- `selectOnModifierClick`: Selects only on Cmd/Ctrl-click, so plain clicks leave the selection.
- `loopSelection`: false stops arrow keys at the first and last row. Defaults to true.
- `columnMovable`: false stops dragging headers to reorder columns. Defaults to true.
- `columnResizable`: false stops dragging header edges to resize columns. Defaults to true.
- `rowHeader`: With cellSelectable, the leading column that selects whole rows; false hides it (clicking a selected cell again then selects its row). Defaults to true.
- `fixedColumnsBorder`: Draws a border after the fixed columns.
- `scrollbarVisible`: false hides the vertical scrollbar. Defaults to true.
- `horizontalScrollbarVisible`: false hides the horizontal scrollbar. Defaults to true.
- `scrollBounce`: Elastic overscroll at the edges.
- `headerRowHeight`: Header row height in pixels.
- `selectedRow`: Selected row by its index in `rows`, controlled; the table scrolls to it.
- `loading`: Shows skeleton rows instead of the data.
- `hasMore`: More rows can load; scrolling near the end fires onLoadMore.
- `loadMoreThreshold`: Rows from the end at which onLoadMore fires. Defaults to 20.
- `accessibilityLabel`: Name screen readers announce for the table.
- `size`: Row size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.
- `scrollResetKey`: Changing this key scrolls to the first row without selecting it. Keep it stable during background updates; use a page/filter identity to reset navigation. No effect on initial selection.
- `manualSorting`: When true, header clicks emit onSort and show the direction but do not reorder the rows; sort the full data in onSort. Defaults to false (rows sort locally).
- `onSelect`: Receives the selected row's index in `rows` (sorting does not change it).
- `onActivate`: Receives a double-clicked row's index.
- `onSelectColumn`: Receives the selected column's key.
- `onSelectCell`: Receives the selected cell as [row index, column key].
- `onActivateCell`: Receives a double-clicked cell as [row index, column key].
- `onSort`: Receives [column key, direction] after a header click; direction is ascending, descending or empty for the original order.
- `onColumnsChange`: Receives the column keys in their new order after a drag.
- `onColumnWidthsChange`: Receives every column width in pixels after a resize.
- `onRightClick`: Receives a right-clicked row's index.
- `onContextMenu`: Receives the row index as its DataTableMenu opens.
- `onClearSelection`: Runs when Escape clears the selection.
- `onLoadMore`: Runs when scrolling nears the end while hasMore is true.
- `children`: DataTableColumn, DataTableCell, DataTableEmpty and DataTableMenu elements.
- `className`: Utility classes. A signal expression updates them live without remounting; unknown utilities throw.

std:ui.name: DockProps
std:ui.documentation:
A workspace of DockPanel elements in resizable splits; users drag tabs to rearrange, stack and split panels. Live keyed DockPanel additions/removals preserve the user layout. Give each panel a distinct value when controlling selection or handling close requests. Explicit text-size classes on Dock apply live to its document-tab labels.

Props (all optional):
- `vertical`: Stacks the panels top to bottom instead of side by side.
- `tabbed`: Initially groups all panels into one tab bar instead of separate splits. Read at mount; subsequent dragging owns the arrangement.
- `value`: Selects the panel with this value in its current group. Update from onChange. Other visible split groups stay open.
- `initialLayout`: A layout saved from onLayoutChange, read when mounted. Restores splits, sizes, tab order and selected tabs by DockPanel.value; missing panels are skipped and new ones appended. Invalid or oversized layouts fall back to the default and call onLayoutError. Panel contents, focus and scroll positions are not restored.
- `onChange`: Reports a panel value when its tab becomes active.
- `onClose`: Reports a panel value after a user closes it. Remove that DockPanel child to accept; retaining it restores the panel. Set closable=false to prevent closing dirty content.
- `onLayoutChange`: Receives a versioned JSON layout after each change. Save it and pass it back as initialLayout; do not edit it. Clone the text to keep it.
- `onLayoutError`: Receives a message when a non-empty initialLayout cannot be restored; the default layout is used. Clone the text to keep it.
- `onCloseAll`: Requests closing all panels through the host. Resolve unsaved data before removing children; no panel is removed automatically.
- `children`: DockPanel elements.
- `className`: Utility classes. A signal expression updates them live without remounting; unknown utilities throw.

```tsrx
<Dock className="h-96"><DockPanel title="Files" size={240}><Tree/></DockPanel><DockPanel title="Editor"><CodeEditor/></DockPanel></Dock>

Click to start; click again to stop and receive the transcript. locale, systemFallback and stopTimeout are read once when mounted. Props (all optional):

- `waveform`: Shows the input level beside the button while listening.

- `onPartial`: Receives the whole transcript so far while the user speaks.
- `onFinal`: Receives the final transcript when the session ends; it may be empty.
- `onError`: Receives a readable message when recognition fails, such as denied microphone access.
- `onStarted`: Called when a session starts capturing audio.

std:ui.name: PlotLineProps
std:ui.documentation:
A line through one value per Plot label.

Props (all optional):
- `values`: Finite numbers, in label order. NaN and infinities throw a UI error. Missing trailing values are omitted; extra values beyond the labels are not drawn. A signal expression updates it live; a plain array is read once.
- `color`: Theme color (chart-1 … chart-5, primary, destructive, foreground, muted-foreground) or #rrggbb. Defaults to the next chart color.
- `curve`: Smooth (default), straight segments, or steps.
- `dots`: Marks each point with a dot.
- `width`: Nonnegative finite stroke width in logical pixels, at most the native float maximum. Defaults to 2; invalid values throw a UI error.
- `label`: Series name in PlotTooltip. Defaults to Series 1, Series 2, and so on in mark order.
- `className`: Utility classes. A signal expression updates them live without remounting; unknown utilities throw.

```tsrx
<PlotLine values={[1, 3, 2]} color="chart-2" curve="step"/>
```

Ownership: consumes its props and children; the returned Node owns its handlers.

An invisible timer for animation: it calls onTick on a fixed interval while running. Update signals in onTick to move things; it stops when unmounted.
